content_preview.summary: Meta is rolling out a mandatory update that disables its smart glasses' camera if the privacy LED is tampered with, even as it reportedly tests always-on glasses that would skip the light entirely.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Meta has begun pushing a mandatory firmware update to its second-generation Ray-Ban Meta glasses, Oakley Meta glasses, and its own self-branded Meta Glasses line that disables the camera if the recording-indicator LED is physically tampered with or destroyed, according to [9to5Google](https://9to5google.com/2026/07/07/meta-ray-ban-smart-glasses-privacy-light-camera-update/) and [TheNextWeb](https://thenextweb.com/news/meta-ray-ban-privacy-light-fix-cameraless).
